goal: Implement #723's locked axes + action projection for the Reviews list: Posted-reply axis (reply_state) and Action slot (row_action) on the wire, Replacement-draft axis (draft_state) server-internal and never crossing the wire, with held projecting to row_action 'none' in every reply_state — so an answered review with a moderation-held replacement draft stops rendering the ordinary Regenerate control into the legacy drawer (invariant #4 as a structural property).
non_goals: The three legacy draft-route server gates — landed at #726; a server gate cannot depend on a client affordance
The Generate route's missing orphan exclusion (orphan×draft reachability leak) — surfaced to map #710, out of scope here
The item-5 maintainability bundle (toCardRow's isOrphan ternaries) beyond what the remodel forces — it is blocked BY this ticket and tidies against the settled shape
Any EditReplyDrawer behavior change — drawer resume/discard of an existing pending replacement is existing behavior
Needs Action surface, /admin/flagged, and re-litigating D-H / D-F / D-C (map-level Out of scope)
user_visible_behavior: posted×held (THE bug cell, the one behavioural delta): live posted reply + provenance badge stay visible; Regenerate is withdrawn — no button, no regen counter, no 'Editing unavailable' lock, no held indication of any kind (silent withdrawal; explaining it would be the notification invariant #4 forbids)

none×held: unchanged from today — the 'Reply on hold / We are double-checking this draft… / Under review' panel, reconstructed client-side from reply_state 'none' + row_action 'none' (owner Q1 call 2026-08-09; the held value itself never crosses the wire)

orphan×generating / orphan×ready / orphan×held: recover — same render as today, but now defined by the total derivation instead of accidental is_orphan-first fallthrough; recovery dominates (locked #723 call), pending draft stays reachable via Needs Action
Every other cell of the 3×4 cross-product renders exactly as today (pinned by the eval)

A posted row with a delete_failed sidecar keeps its 'This reply needs attention' recovery control in every draft state including held — recovery addresses the failed response, not the held draft, and #726 owns the server-side hold checks (mirrors the locked orphan×held rationale)
invariants: Invariant #4: a moderation-held draft surfaces neither its text nor any affordance; the draft axis (draft_state / draft_held / draft_response_id) never appears in the wire shape (ReviewsListRow / PastReplyRow)
The live posted reply stays visible in every posted×* cell — axis A owns the reply panel (the answered-row regression guard from the ticket)
The Answered/Unanswered row split is identical to today: reply_state === 'posted' selects exactly the old regenerate row set
Intra-axis draft precedence preserved: a settled response row outranks an in-flight outbox row (held > ready > generating > none)
The card renders a state, it never computes one (D-D) — the derivation lives only in replies-view.ts
The (reply_state, draft_state) → row_action derivation is total over all 12 cells — exhaustive switch, no default fallthrough
Tenant scoping of load-replies untouched (invariant #8); no query predicate changes
edge_cases: posted×held with a present regen budget entry — the counter must not render (it renders only beside the button)
posted×held with canEdit false — no 'Editing unavailable' lock either (the lock explains an affordance slot that is empty)
posted×held with a delete_failed fail-sidecar — RecoveryControl still renders (see user_visible_behavior)
none×none with editRepliesEnabled false — unchanged Generate panel (Generate is deliberately ungated by that flag)
row_action 'none' is inferable as 'probably held' by an observant owner — accepted at #723; a fake affordance that errors would be worse
useEditReplyDraft.test.tsx and every fixture constructing PastReplyRow/ReviewsListRow loses row_state and gains the two typed fields — excess-property checks make TypeScript catch stragglers
InlineGeneratePanel resumeGenerating keys off row_action === 'generating' (only reachable when reply_state is 'none')
